board: GY-91 10DOF MPU9250 + BMP280 purple module (8-pin: VIN, 3V3, GND, SCL, SDA, SDO/SAO, NCS, CSB)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run: the MPU-9250 (accel/gyro/temp at 0x68) and the AK8963 magnetometer (0x0C) and BMP280 (0x76) sub-devices are modelled. BMP280 raw values are solved with Bosch's floating-point compensation over calibration registers, and the driver follows the datasheet sequences.
